_README: The California Public 100 — the to-play list. Two compilations (ChatGPT, 2026-10-06): a
ranked table of published public-access rankings, then the 'Amar Score' index that revised
the canonical hundred and scored every course 0–10 on nine components. Transcribed
verbatim and then CHECKED row by row.
CONTRACT (enforced by scripts/validate.mjs):
- exactly 100 entries, ranks 1..100 unique, slugs unique kebab-case;
- unknown values are null, never guessed — a '~129' slope is null until a page states it;
- fee is an approximate 2026 posted band {low, high, note}, never a quotation;
- facilitySlug / layoutSlug join the spine (data/facilities.json, data/layouts.json),
explicit and never fuzzy; a layoutSlug the spine lacks is allowed and reads as
'facility played, this course not'; an entry that LOOKS like a spine facility but
is not must say why in joinNote;
- provenance.checks holds one check per claim group (rankings = Golfweek + GOLF, golfDigest, tee, fee, architect):
{verified, source, note}; a verified check names its source (a URL or a key in _sources);
provenance.verified is true only when every check is; confidence is high|medium|low;
- amar is the index's own taste scoring — nine 0–10 components, the weighted score and the
rank it implies (_amar.weights; validate recomputes both). It is an opinion, not a claim
about the world, so no check applies to it; drive is an estimate from central SF,
housing the index's call on how much of the routing is lined with houses.
Hand-editable. The page /california and the dossier on /courses read it; build.mjs
derives published rankings for the facilities it links to. Only US-scale ranks
(golfweekUS, golfDigestPublic, golfYCP) feed the externalRanking vector — a state #1
is not a national #1.

_amar.title: Amar score
_amar.note: The index's own weighting of taste, 0–100: nine components scored 0–10, the weighted mean times ten. Architecture carries the most; scenery is marked down for visible housing; 'worth the drive' is roughly 70% how rewarding the course is and 30% how near. Spanish Bay scores access 0 while closed. An opinion to argue with, not a fact.
